downstream_rule: E3 may start only after this checkpoint is confirmed; confirmation does not promote E2 or authorize E3 integration with unmerged E2 state.

scope.core_inference: local open model through loopback vLLM
explicit_non_goals: PDF, image, audio, or video ingestion

errors.422: request or M1 state transition violates the frozen contract
errors.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: local model is unavailable and the last durable asset version is retained
errors.POLICY_BLOCKED: Runtime denied the proposed tool effect
errors.INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT: model output failed the structured proposal contract

contracts.progress: M1 progress is derived from the saved version, confirmed statements, unresolved questions, artifact state, and durable terminal state; no ETA or invented percentage is emitted.
invalidation: Every accepted edit, answer, skip, defer, pause, resume, or confirmation creates or selects a durable canonical version.
A stale expected_version_id fails with HTTP 409 and cannot overwrite the current version.
Editing a completed M1 asset reopens M1 and invalidates the displayed Agent run derived from the prior version.
No M2 state exists in this checkpoint; downstream M2 must bind to the accepted M1 version after E2 promotion.

migrations.reason: The existing SQLite snapshot repository stores the complete canonical JSON version; M1 adds no numbered migration.

m1_expected: create a saved Experience Brief from the adapted source
keep source facts traceable without copying identity or treating source text as policy
surface no more than three explained unresolved questions
allow skip, defer, pause, resume, or completion with visible gaps
retain conflicting source statements and ask the user to resolve them
m1_forbidden: silently choose or merge conflicting facts

m1_expected: create a new version and mark the superseded user judgment corrected
restore the last durable version, questions, milestone state, and allowed actions

negative_cases: adapted public fixture without URL and provenance notice
SKIP or DEFER carrying answer text
confirm with unresolved questions unless complete_with_gaps is explicit
imported prompt injection proposing an unavailable tool
current-source search without explicit user permission
cross-asset, publishing, network, shell, export, or approval tool proposal

track_2: Tool Calling proposal separated from Runtime permission
